name: leetclawd
description: LeetCode in the Claude Code UI: /leetclawd shows it while Claude thinks, /leetclawdf keeps it open, /unleetclawd clears it.

language.title: Default language
language.description: The language a problem opens in.

delaySeconds.title: Thinking delay (seconds)
delaySeconds.description: How long Claude must have been working before LeetCode appears.

session.title: LEETCODE_SESSION cookie
session.description: Your leetcode.com session cookie, needed to run and submit. The Account screen can also import it from Safari or take it pasted.

shortcutKey.title: Shortcut key
shortcutKey.description: The key that leads a LeetClawd shortcut when typed in an empty prompt box: twice to show or hide it, then a button's letter to press that button. One character that is not a letter, a digit or one of / ! @ # ? &.
